document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The amulet burns in your hand as it summons forth a strange 
entity, and then another, and then another. A shrill piping sound 
echoes around you as gigantic bubble-mass horrors tumble 
forward from corridors and caverns, clashing with the entities 
you have brought here. The battle between them is desperate. 
Go to 571.
(567)
